![Mobilize Power V2G in Gladys](https://github.com/Gaetanb76/gladys-mobilize-v2g/raw/HEAD/./cover.jpg)

Follow in Gladys the charges and the energy sent back by your car on a **Mobilize Powerbox Verso** with the **Mobilize Power** offer: charging cost, V2G hours gain, subscription and balance, per day, month and year.

## Requirements

- A **Mobilize Powerbox Verso** on your local network (Wi-Fi or Ethernet), with a **fixed IP address** (set it in your router).
- The **password of the installer account** of the borne, printed on its label (user `installer`).

The integration reads the borne **read-only**: it never changes its settings and does not interfere with Mobilize Power or the My Renault app.

## Setup

1. **Configuration** tab: the borne's IP address, user and password, then **Test the connection to the Powerbox**. Gladys hides the password as you type it: this button confirms it is right ("OK") or refused.
2. Your contract's **subscribed power** (for the subscription).
3. **Discovery** tab: create the "Mobilize Power V2G" device.
4. Dashboard: add the **V2G balance** widget and pick the period (today, this month, this year).

### Updating from version 0.1

Version 0.1 misread the car's presence (always "plugged") and declared features Gladys duplicated as "(consumption)" and "(cost)". After the update, delete the "Mobilize Power V2G" device (**Devices** tab) and create it again from the **Discovery** tab. The V2G hours estimated before the update are reset; the energy and the official hours you entered are kept.

## The calculation

| Line | Calculation |
|---|---|
| Charging cost | kWh charged × price per kWh |
| Subscription | annual subscription × days of the period ÷ days of the year |
| V2G bonus | V2G hours × V2G Hour rate |
| Buyback of the energy sent back | kWh sent back × buyback price (0 by default) |
| **Balance** | charging + subscription − V2G bonus − buyback |

A negative balance is a gain.

The tariffs come from the grid published on [mobilize-v2g.fr](https://www.mobilize-v2g.fr/fr_fr), read once a day (built-in fallback: the August 2026 grid). A value entered in the configuration always wins over the grid.

The **V2G hours are estimated** from the time the car is plugged in (Mobilize counts them only once the minimum charge level is reached and until the departure time). The car is detected on the socket's control pilot: a cable left in the borne without a car does not count. Enter the official figure of a month with the **Official V2G hours** button of the widget, or the action of the same name in the configuration.

## Limits

- The borne's local API is not documented by Mobilize: a firmware update could change it.
- If the borne or Gladys is unreachable for more than 10 minutes, that time is not counted as V2G hours; the energy is caught up thanks to the borne's counters.
- Amounts are TTC (taxes included), computed with the grid prices: the invoice may differ slightly.
- In **Discovery**, Gladys shows a "$" icon for every currency feature whatever the currency: the amounts are in euros (unit €).

## Configuration settings

These are the settings Mobilize Power V2G asks for in its configuration screen in Gladys.

| Setting | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Your Mobilize Powerbox Verso | `section` | No | The integration reads the borne on your local network, read-only: it never changes its settings and does not interfere with Mobilize Power. The user and password are those of the installer account, printed on the label of the borne. Give the borne a fixed IP address in your router. |
| Powerbox IP address | `string` | No |  |
| Powerbox user | `string` | No |  |
| Powerbox password (installer account) | `secret` | No | Hidden as you type it: after saving, the "Test the connection to the Powerbox" button says whether it is right. |
| Read the borne every (seconds) | `number` | No |  |
| Tariffs (TTC) | `section` | No | By default the tariffs come from the grid published on mobilize-v2g.fr, read once a day. A value you enter below always wins over the grid; leave it empty to follow the grid. The V2G gain is the V2G hours times the V2G Hour rate. The V2G hours are estimated from the time the car is plugged in: enter the official figure of a month from the widget or below. |
| Read the tariff grid on mobilize-v2g.fr | `boolean` | No |  |
| Subscribed power | `select` | No |  |
| Price per kWh (€, empty = grid) | `number` | No |  |
| V2G Hour rate (€ per hour, empty = grid) | `number` | No |  |
| Annual subscription (€, empty = grid for your power) | `number` | No |  |
| Count the subscription in the balance | `boolean` | No |  |
| Buyback of the energy sent back (€/kWh, 0 = none) | `number` | No | The Mobilize information sheet says the energy sent back is bought at the selling price; the V2G hours are the main gain. Leave 0 unless your invoice shows such a credit. |

## How to install Mobilize Power V2G in Gladys

1. In Gladys, open **Integrations**: Mobilize Power V2G appears in the catalog, next to the native integrations, with a community badge.
2. Click **Install**. Gladys pulls the Docker image (`ghcr.io/gaetanb76/gladys-mobilize-v2g:0.2.0`), starts it in a sandbox isolated from the core, and generates the integration's interface (devices, discovery and configuration).
3. Open the **Configuration** screen of the integration, fill in the settings, and save.
4. You can also install it directly from its repository URL: [https://github.com/Gaetanb76/gladys-mobilize-v2g](https://github.com/Gaetanb76/gladys-mobilize-v2g).

Mobilize Power V2G requires Gladys `>=5.1.0`. The catalog inside Gladys refreshes every hour, so a new version becomes available at most one hour after its release.

Not running Gladys yet? It is free and open source: [follow the installation guide](/docs/) to get started.

## About external integrations

Mobilize Power V2G is an **external integration**: a community integration packaged as a Docker container and published on GitHub, that Gladys installs in one click and runs in a sandbox isolated from its core. It is published and maintained by [Gaetanb76](https://github.com/Gaetanb76), not by the Gladys core team.
